tool_calls.arguments:
{"reply":"Yes, you can put the whole monthly surplus on the card. The main trade-off is speed against flexibility.

If you send the whole surplus to the credit card, it is paid off in 3 months and the car loan also finishes sooner. But the emergency fund gets no monthly contribution for now, and the house fund stops being on track while that is happening.

If you want to keep more flexibility, you can keep the emergency-fund contribution and still put the rest on the card. That clears the card later than the full-push option, but it keeps cash building for emergencies.
